use_cases: Showcasing product images with hidden details that reveal on hover
Displaying blog post previews with gradient overlays in media applications
Creating interactive portfolio cards for creator and design portfolios
Building featured content sections on SaaS landing pages
Designing contact or profile cards with expandable information
ai_summary: A hover card component featuring an image with a gradient overlay that reveals sliding content from the bottom on mouse hover. Supports multiple color variants (default green, primary blue, secondary amber) and size options. Includes smooth scale transitions on the image and slide-up animations for content, with full dark mode support for modern web applications.
